styles.name: beer-glass
styles.description: Row of glass beer mugs with handles filling amber in turn; foam heads and rising bubbles

styles.name: coffee-pour
styles.description: Coffee pot pours a wavering stream into a row of mugs one by one; full mugs steam

styles.name: pizza-slices
styles.description: Row of pepperoni pizza slices served in turn; the newest one stretches a swaying cheese string

styles.name: boiling-pot
styles.description: Steel pot with handles fills with bubbling water; bubbles burst at the surface and steam rises

styles.name: sushi-conveyor
styles.description: Salmon and tamago nigiri glide along a moving conveyor belt that fills with progress

styles.name: popcorn-popping
styles.description: Striped popcorn boxes heap up with fluffy kernels in turn while fresh ones pop into the air

styles.name: egg-timer
styles.description: Row of wooden-capped hourglass egg timers — each drains a trickle of sand from its top bulb into a growing heap, one after another

styles.name: pancake-stack
styles.description: Golden pancakes stack up on a plate one by one, topped with butter and dripping syrup

styles.name: candy-jar
styles.description: Lidded glass jar fills with multicoloured round sweets from the bottom up as one more drops in

styles.name: noodle-slurp
styles.description: Chopsticks lift a wiggly noodle from a red ramen bowl; it is slurped shorter as progress grows

styles.name: toast-browning
styles.description: Two bread slices sink into a chrome toaster and brown with progress, popping up at 100%

styles.name: pie-sweep
styles.description: Domed lattice pie in a tin: the woven golden crust sweeps across as progress grows, steaming
